field_descriptions.by_artist: The artist that performed this album or recording.
field_descriptions.duration: The duration of the item (movie, audio recording, event, etc.) in [ISO 8601 duration format](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601).
field_descriptions.identifier: The identifier property represents any kind of identifier for any kind of [[Thing]], such as ISBNs, GTIN codes, UUIDs etc. Schema.org provides dedicated properties for representing many of these, either as textual strings or as URL (URI) links. See [background notes](/docs/datamodel.html#identifierBg) for more details.
field_descriptions.in_album: The album to which this recording belongs.
field_descriptions.in_playlist: The playlist to which this recording belongs.
field_descriptions.isrc_code: The International Standard Recording Code for the recording.
field_descriptions.recording_of: The composition this track is a recording of.
